project_name: Igreja Casa da Oração - Landing Page
concept: Editorial newspaper, handmade torn paper aesthetic, religious modern design.

fonts.usage: Headings, Numbers, Display. Premium editorial feel, use italics for emphasis.
Body, UI elements, small labels. Clean and readable.

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl font-serif tracking-tight leading-none
hierarchy.caption: text-xs sm:text-sm font-sans uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-[#655D53]

torn_paper_effect.strategy: Apply an SVG mask or CSS clip-path to the main content container to create irregular, organic torn edges. Add an SVG filter 'feTurbulence' and 'feDisplacementMap' for realistic paper edge roughness. Apply a subtle drop shadow under the paper to separate it from the dark background.
torn_paper_effect.implementation: Wrap the main content in a container with 'max-w-[1280px] mx-auto w-[calc(100%-20px)] md:w-[calc(100%-80px)]'. Use 'bg-[#F0E9DB]'. Add a custom SVG filter defined in the HTML body to apply to the container using 'filter: url(#torn-edge) drop-shadow(0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.5))'.

paper_texture.description: A very subtle noise or grain SVG overlay on the paper background to give it tactile depth, avoiding a flat digital look.

photography_treatment.description: Images should feel like printed editorial photos. Use grayscale with high contrast, or muted warm tones. Some images should have torn edges or be slightly tilted with a subtle 'tape' element (a small div with white semi-transparent background rotated) to simulate a scrapbook.

components_strategy.Header: Sticky translucent paper header. 'backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#F0E9DB]/80'. Logo is placed inside a dark chip 'bg-[#171411] rounded-sm p-2' because the logo is white line-art. Mobile menu slides down smoothly.
components_strategy.Hero: Kinetic editorial composition. Large church photo partially overlapped by paper pieces. Strong title with Framer Motion line-by-line reveal ('overflow-hidden', translating Y from 100%). CTA buttons: 'bg-[#171411] text-[#FFFDF7] rounded-none px-6 py-3 font-sans uppercase tracking-widest text-xs hover:bg-[#A9653A] transition-colors'.
components_strategy.Section_Manifesto: Numbered chapters. Use huge serif numbers ('text-7xl text-[#A9653A]/20'). Text flows alongside.
components_strategy.Section_Services: Horários dos cultos. Clean typography. No cards, just pure text layouts with horizontal dividing lines ('border-t border-[#655D53]/30').
components_strategy.Section_Events: Slow editorial marquee for upcoming events using framer-motion or a marquee library. 'font-serif text-3xl italic text-[#A9653A]'.
components_strategy.Section_Gallery: Overlapping photos with scrapbook aesthetic. Use absolute positioning within a relative container for desktop. Subtle parallax on scroll.
components_strategy.Footer: Minimalist. Huge 'Casa da Oração' text spanning full width of the paper. Dark chip logo again.

motion.scrolling: Lenis for smooth, momentum-based scrolling. Essential for the premium editorial feel.
animations: Scroll: Fade-up and slight Y-axis translation for sections.
Parallax: External background stays fixed or moves very slowly. Some gallery images move at different speeds.
motion.accessibility: Always respect 'prefers-reduced-motion: reduce' by disabling complex parallax and transforms.

image_urls.description: Group of people watching concert/worship, emotional and atmospheric.
People raising their hands in worship.
Person reading the bible on a wooden table.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure #25211D text on #F0E9DB paper passes WCAG AA. Accent color #A9653A must be readable on the paper.
accessibility.interactions: All interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs) must have 'data-testid' attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup Lenis in a Layout component wrapping the app for smooth scrolling.
2. Add Google Fonts (Cormorant Garamond and Manrope) to index.html or global CSS.
4. Create the main paper container with bg-[#F0E9DB]. Add CSS or SVG masking to create the torn edges on the outer container. Do NOT use border-radius.
5. Use Framer Motion for line-by-line reveals in the hero section.

6. Build the sticky header. Ensure the logo (which is white at /app/frontend/src/assets/logo.png) is placed inside a dark background element (e.g., a dark rectangle or badge) so it is visible on the light paper.
7. Do NOT use pure transparent backgrounds for text-heavy overlays. Use solid or blurred backgrounds.
8. Follow the design system rigorously—no standard Shadcn cards with borders and rounded corners. Everything must feel like printed paper.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Avoid centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Use glass-morphism effects carefully; in this specific design, rely more on solid paper textures and solid color blocks than glass.
Do not apply universal transition (`transition: all`).
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters.
Implement micro-animations on all interactive elements.
All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button').
